kicker: Tencent Hy4, checked without its weights

scenes.headline: What Hy4 changed from its preview
scenes.sub: Tencent's full release, read from the files that exist
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lookout! Tencent's Hy4 is the full release of its seven hundred seventy billion parameter preview, now with vision. Here's what changed.

scenes.label: What is new
scenes.text: Hy4 adds image input and computer use to the preview, but ships no weights, no model card and no licence yet.
scenes.say: Hy4 adds image input and computer use, but ships no weights, model card or licence yet. So the checks run on the endpoint and the preview's files.

scenes.title: How a model points at an image

steps.note: how patches enter is not visible yet
steps.say: An image goes in. How its patches reach the backbone isn't visible yet: the preview's vocabulary has no image token.
What comes out is ordinary text.
To point at something, it writes a coordinate between point tags. The text-only preview already reserved fourteen such grounding tokens.

left.title: Hy4 preview
left.say: The preview took text only, shipped Apache licensed weights, and accepted the usual sampling controls.

right.title: Hy4
items: Served only by Tencent, at fp4
right.say: Hy4 takes images too. Only Tencent serves it, at four-bit precision, with temperature and stop as the only sampling controls.

scenes.title: KV cache per token, preview backbone

parts.say: Multi-latent attention keeps five hundred seventy-six values per layer, across seventy-eight layers, at two bytes each.

parts.note: only 21 layers keep an indexer key
parts.say: IndexCache gives only twenty-one layers their own sparse-attention key.
About ninety-seven gigabytes for one full million-token window.

steps.say: Tencent's chart compares Hy4 with three open models and two closed ones, on Tencent's own runs.
On OSWorld, the computer use benchmark, Hy4 sits third, behind Kimi and Claude.

scenes.title: Chart panels where Hy4 is ahead
scenes.note: four of the six are Tencent-internal
scenes.say: Counted from that chart: ahead of DeepSeek Flash on all twelve, ahead of the best open rival on six, four of them internal, and ahead of all five on none.

scenes.text: Until tencent/Hy4 ships, its size, architecture and licence are only claims; the preview's files are the closest evidence.
scenes.say: Until the weights ship, Hy4's size, architecture and licence are claims. The preview's files are the closest evidence.

recap: Image input; grounding tokens already reserved
Hosted only, at fp4, no weights
Ahead of DeepSeek Flash on 12 of 12
scenes.say: To recap: vision on a vocabulary that was ready for it, a hosted model at four bits, and a clear lead over DeepSeek Flash.
